Glossary

daisugi is designed as an engine curation metarepo. there are a handful of nomenclature below that will be helpful for navigating the package. all machines are fitted with (x, y) interfaces. the machines are dictated with a prefix verb. Those are listed below:

Keywords

fit machines with: grow_
infer machines with: harvest_
